February noun

classical

Sen. Ep. 86.20: mēnse Februāriō
Traupman 77
Traupman 314

Februārius, Februāria, Februārium

adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis) · Declension on Wiktionary

of February; February

The month of the februa, rites of purification (Ov. F. 2.19, 31, rightly: de Vaan 208, s.v. februum). Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Februāriae: the 1st, 5th and 13th. In a leap year the extra day falls before the Kalends of March (see leap year).

Examples

  • vīdī nōn tantum mēnse Februāriō positās, sed etiam Mārtiō exāctō

    I have seen vines planted not only in February but even at the end of MarchSen. Ep. 86.20

  • mēnse Februāriō

    in FebruaryTraupman 314

See also month, January, March, leap year.
